name: opus
local_changes: The upstream release archive is pruned for Runtime's CMake build. Program and test targets are disabled; retained demo, unit-test, documentation, Meson and Autotools files are not compiled; unused DNN assets are excluded.
The wrapper declares NEON as required on Runtime's supported ARM64 targets because Opus 1.5.2 does not recognize Apple's arm64 processor spelling.
The MinGW CMake path consumes the compiler-owned absolute libssp.a selected by the Runtime wrapper so the Windows aggregate does not retain an undeclared dynamic libssp dependency.
